podcast.body: This song is from Anberlin, an Orlando-based group signed to Tooth and Nail. It is presented as an example of contemporary Christian rock that defies traditional expectations of "grandma's religious music." "This is called Embrace the Dead."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
